title: Mitigating Fine-tuning based Jailbreak Attack with Backdoor Enhanced Safety Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'Safety Alignment,' which is the practical implementation of ethical guardrails for AI behavior. It evaluates the model's adherence to safety policies (which define ethical and harmful behavior) using the Policy-Oriented Safety Evaluation Benchmarks, which categorize prohibited content like illegal activities, hate speech, and harassment.
